diagnosis.what_happened: Agents generated inline colon-delimited listicles (e.g. 'جنسیت: ... پایه تحصیلی: ...') inside academic paragraphs.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Writing fragmented, telegraphic label-colon pairs compromised the high-quality professional continuous prose expected in thesis deliverables.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Empirical parameters should have been woven into flowing, cohesive narrative paragraphs using scholarly transitions.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Formal academic writing demands continuous discourse; inline colons function as pseudo-bullets which violate the formal scholarly register.

desired_behavior: Never use inline colon-delimited labels or telegraphic pseudo-bullets (**موضوع:** ... **موضوع بعدی:** ...) in formal academic prose. Always weave empirical parameters into flowing, cohesive narrative paragraphs using scholarly transitions.
generalization: All academic narratives must be continuous scholarly discourse; structural crutches like inline label-colon pairs are prohibited.
